summary: Idaho lookout on the Nez Perce-Clearwater NF: camp from 1914, 10x10 cab 1922, L-4 cab on a 10-ft tower 1939; staffed each summer, drive-up.

facts.design: 10-foot timber tower with an L-4 cab and a Bosworth fire finder

access.note: Drive-up and staffed each summer. The Forest Service says the seasonal lookout does not mind visitors. Ask the Salmon River Ranger District before planning a visit.

facts.agency: USDA Forest Service, Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests (Salmon River Ranger District)

events.note: Lookout camp established; a July 1914 newspaper report says Tom Crossley set up a lookout station there
Forest guard George E. Watkins reported on duty at the station in July 1914
Watkins and Levi Colgrove struck by lightning in August 1916; the telephone near their tent was destroyed
10x10 ft frame cabin with a hip roof
L-4 cab on a 10-foot timber tower; the register dates the cab design to 1932
Gary Dutcher finishes his 40th consecutive season at the lookout

corrections.why: The Register gives N 45.905560 W 115.708330, about 120 km south-west of the record point. The Forest Service places the lookout between Clearwater and Elk City, which fits the Register point. A human should confirm before changing it.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register's 1932 date is the design model of the L-4 cab. Its construction date on the 10-foot tower is 1939, the same year Forest Lookouts and Fire Lookout give.

sources.title: On the Lookout: Celebrating 40 Years at Pilot Knob Lookout
sources.publisher: USDA Forest Service, Nez Perce-Clearwater National Forests

notes_for_editor: The history (1914 camp, 1922 cab, 1939 L-4 cab on a 10-ft tower) agrees across four sources. Current staffing rests on a Forest Service release dated 2024-10-29 and on Fire Lookout's 'every summer'; no 2025 or 2026 confirmation was read. An idahofirelookouts.com site comment (not used as a source) says Dutcher staffed through 2025, so staffing may need a check. Access is 'public' because the site is listed as drive-up and staffed; no closure or climbing rule was found, so visit.climbable is omitted. The record location (46.72659, -114.64706) is about 120 km from the Register point, so a location correction is proposed for a human to check. The record kind 'unknown' could be set to 'tower' (a 10-ft tower with an L-4 cab). height_m is omitted because the sources give a 10-ft tower without a clear cab-floor height. Used 1 websearch.py call and 6 page reads.
